title: Validate settings with a dependency-injected validator
goal: Register a reusable settings validator by type and resolve its policy dependencies through DI before startup accepts work.

selectionNotes: Validate<TValidator> remains synchronous unless the validator implements the asynchronous contract.
Choose dependency lifetimes suitable for options registration; do not capture scoped services in singleton consumers.
